name: Google Ads API
summary: Programmatically read Google Ads campaign, search-term, conversion, and reporting data for repeatable performance workflows.
whatItDoes: The Google Ads API provides structured access to account entities and reports, including campaign performance, search terms, conversion actions, budgets, and bidding settings. It is most useful after a manual workflow has been validated and recurring exports become burdensome.
dataAvailable: Campaign and ad group performance metrics
Search terms and keyword metrics when reportable
Conversion actions, categories, status, and settings
Budgets, bidding strategies, targeting, and account structure
actionsSupported: Query reports with Google Ads Query Language
Create and update campaign entities with appropriate permissions
authenticationType: OAuth 2.0 plus a Google Ads developer token and customer account access
privacyNotes: Advertising data may reveal business strategy, spend, customer-intent patterns, and account identifiers. Use least-privilege access, protect developer tokens and refresh tokens, and avoid autonomous campaign changes without review.
